name: Shakshuka
blurb: Eggs poached in a smoky pepper-and-tomato sauce. One pan, plenty of bread, ready before you've laid the table.

name: Banana Bread
blurb: The reliable one. Dark, dense and just sweet enough — the answer to three sad bananas on the counter.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
blurb: Garlic, oil, chilli, pasta. Five ingredients, fifteen minutes, and a lesson in how good restraint can taste.

name: Lemon & Herb Chicken Thighs
blurb: Crisp-skinned thighs roasted with lemon, garlic and woody herbs. The tray does all the work while you sit down.

name: Red Lentil Dahl
blurb: Soft, golden and deeply savoury, finished with a sizzling garlic tadka poured over at the table.

name: Caramelised Onion & Gruyère Galette
blurb: A free-form tart of slow, sweet onions under nutty melted gruyère. Looks like effort; mostly just patience.

name: Charred Broccoli, Garlic & Chilli
blurb: Roasted hard until the edges crackle, then hit with garlic, chilli and lemon. The way to convert a sceptic.

name: Smashed Cucumber Salad
blurb: Bruised, salted cucumbers that drink up a sharp sesame-and-garlic dressing. Cold, crunchy, ten minutes of work.

name: Olive Oil & Dark Chocolate Cookies
blurb: Fudgy, faintly savoury and finished with flaky salt — made with oil, so there's nothing to soften or wait for.

name: Buttermilk Pancakes
blurb: Tall, tender and weekend-worthy. A proper stack worth getting out of bed for, ready in under half an hour.

name: Bircher Muesli
blurb: Oats soaked overnight with apple and yoghurt, so breakfast is already waiting when you stumble into the kitchen.

name: Avocado & Chilli Eggs on Toast
blurb: The modern classic, done properly: lemony avocado, a soft poached egg, and a hit of chilli on good sourdough.

name: Breakfast Hash
blurb: Crisp potatoes, peppers and mushrooms with eggs baked right in. A whole brunch cooked in one big pan.

name: Roasted Tomato Soup
blurb: Tomatoes roasted until sweet and jammy, then blitzed smooth. A world away from anything out of a tin.

name: Greek Salad
blurb: Just-ripe tomatoes, crisp cucumber and a slab of feta under good oil and oregano. Summer on a plate.

name: Chickpea, Feta & Herb Salad
blurb: A bright, protein-heavy bowl that comes together with a tin and a few herbs — and travels brilliantly.

name: Spinach & Cheese Frittata
blurb: Eggs, greens and cheddar set into golden wedges. Just as good cold from the fridge the next day.

name: Halloumi Grain Bowl
blurb: Golden fried halloumi over grains and roasted veg, with a honey-lemon dressing. Hearty without being heavy.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
blurb: The slow-simmered ragù that earns its place in the rotation. Low effort, long reward — start it and walk away.

name: Thai Green Chicken Curry
blurb: Fragrant, coconut-rich and on the table in half an hour. Adjust the heat to taste and serve over jasmine rice.

name: Chilli Con Carne
blurb: Smoky, thick and made for a crowd. Better the next day, so make double and bank a future dinner.

name: Salmon & Vegetable Traybake
blurb: Salmon, potatoes and summer veg roasted on one tray. Maximum dinner, minimum washing up.

name: Mushroom Risotto
blurb: Creamy, comforting and quietly impressive. Twenty minutes of gentle stirring is the whole secret.

name: Chicken Stir-Fry
blurb: Fast, fresh and endlessly adaptable. Get everything chopped first and it's done in the time rice takes to cook.

name: Greek Yoghurt & Berry Bowl
blurb: Thick yoghurt, fresh berries and crunch — high-protein and ready in the time it takes the kettle to boil.

name: Veggie Breakfast Burrito
blurb: Soft scrambled eggs, peppers and cheese rolled up to go. A proper breakfast you can eat one-handed.

name: Mushroom & Spinach Omelette
blurb: Buttery mushrooms and greens folded into a soft omelette — fast, savoury and naturally low-carb.

name: Overnight Chia Pudding
blurb: Make-ahead and nutrient-dense — chia soaked in milk until thick, ready to top and go.

name: Tuna Niçoise Salad
blurb: A bistro classic — tuna, egg, potato and beans over leaves. Substantial, fresh and high in protein.

name: Caprese & Pesto Ciabatta
blurb: Mozzarella, ripe tomato and basil pressed into ciabatta with pesto. Ten minutes to a proper lunch.

name: Lentil & Vegetable Soup
blurb: A thick, savoury bowlful of lentils and veg. Cheap, filling and freezes brilliantly for the week.

name: Falafel Wrap
blurb: Crisp falafel, hummus and crunchy salad rolled in warm flatbread with a drizzle of tahini.

name: Sausage & White Bean Casserole
blurb: Sausages braised with beans in a smoky tomato sauce. One pot, deeply comforting, ready for the table.

name: Margherita Pizza
blurb: Blistered crust, simple tomato, melting mozzarella and basil. The one everyone actually wants.

name: Beef & Broccoli Noodles
blurb: Seared beef and crisp broccoli in a glossy soy-garlic sauce over noodles. Faster than a takeaway.

name: Roast Vegetable & Feta Pasta
blurb: Roasted veg and a block of feta melted into a creamy sauce, tossed straight through pasta.

name: Fish Pie
blurb: Flaky fish in a creamy sauce under a golden mash lid. Proper comfort food, worth the little effort.

name: Chicken Katsu Curry
blurb: Crisp breaded chicken over rice with a mellow, lightly sweet curry sauce. A guaranteed crowd-pleaser.

name: Grilled Chicken & Quinoa Bowl
blurb: Lean grilled chicken over fluffy quinoa with griddled courgette and rocket. Balanced and filling.

name: Baked Salmon with Greens
blurb: Salmon roasted with tenderstem and asparagus — omega-rich, low-carb and on the table in 25 minutes.

name: Tofu & Vegetable Stir-Fry
blurb: Crisp tofu and crunchy veg in a light soy-sesame sauce. Plant-based, quick and genuinely satisfying.

name: Turkey & Veg Meatballs
blurb: Lean turkey meatballs with hidden veg, simmered in tomato sauce. Lighter than beef, just as good.

name: Sweet Potato & Black Bean Bowl
blurb: Roasted sweet potato, spiced black beans and avocado over rice. Hearty, plant-based and full of fibre.

name: Egg & Veg Scramble
blurb: Soft eggs scrambled through spinach, tomato and mushroom. Protein-packed, low-carb, five-minute fuel.

name: Courgetti with Turkey Bolognese
blurb: A lighter take on bolognese — lean turkey ragù over spiralised courgette instead of pasta.

name: Salmon Poke-Style Rice Bowl
blurb: Cubed salmon over seasoned rice with edamame, cucumber and avocado. Fresh, balanced and bright.

name: Lemon Herb Cod with Veg
blurb: Flaky cod roasted over courgette, peppers and tomatoes with lemon and herbs. Light but properly satisfying.

name: Chickpea & Spinach Curry
blurb: A lighter curry — chickpeas and spinach in a spiced tomato sauce with just a little coconut. Big on flavour.

name: Greek Chicken Salad Bowl
blurb: Grilled chicken over a crisp Greek-style salad with feta and olives. Fresh, high-protein, low effort.

name: Miso-Glazed Aubergine with Greens
blurb: Aubergine roasted soft then glazed with sweet-savoury miso, served with greens and rice. Quietly impressive.

name: Porridge with Banana & Honey
blurb: Warm, creamy oats topped with banana and a drizzle of honey. The cheapest, cosiest start there is.

name: Smoked Salmon & Cream Cheese Bagel
blurb: Toasted bagel, soft cheese and silky smoked salmon. A deli classic in five minutes flat.

name: Berry Smoothie Bowl
blurb: A thick, spoonable smoothie under a crunchy topping. Bright, refreshing and packed with fruit.

name: French Toast
blurb: Custardy, golden and faintly spiced. A weekend treat that uses up the last of the loaf.

name: Scrambled Eggs on Toast
blurb: Soft, slow-scrambled eggs piled on buttered sourdough. Simple done properly.

name: Breakfast Tacos
blurb: Soft tacos loaded with scrambled egg, avocado, cheese and salsa. A bright, handheld start.

name: Chocolate Brownies
blurb: Fudgy in the middle, crackly on top. The brownie everyone keeps coming back to the tin for.

name: Lemon Drizzle Loaf
blurb: Tender sponge soaked in sharp lemon syrup. A teatime classic that's almost impossible to get wrong.

name: Eton Mess
blurb: Cream, crushed meringue and strawberries thrown together. Five minutes to the easiest crowd-pleaser there is.

name: Apple Crumble
blurb: Soft spiced apples under a buttery, oaty crumble. Pure comfort, best with a pour of custard.

name: No-Bake Cheesecake
blurb: A cool, creamy set filling on a buttery biscuit base. No oven, no fuss — just a little patience.

name: Chocolate Mug Cake
blurb: A warm, gooey chocolate cake in a single mug, in the microwave, in two minutes. Dangerous knowledge.

name: Classic Hummus
blurb: Silky, lemony and garlicky — better than any tub. Keep a batch for dipping all week.

name: Oat & Date Energy Balls
blurb: No-bake bites of oats, dates and peanut butter. A handful beats reaching for the biscuit tin.

name: Spiced Roasted Chickpeas
blurb: Crunchy, smoky and moreish — a high-fibre snack that disappears as fast as crisps.

name: Flapjacks
blurb: Chewy, golden oat bars held together with butter and syrup. A lunchbox stalwart for good reason.

name: Green Smoothie
blurb: Spinach you can't taste, fruit you can. A fresh, energising start that sneaks in your greens.

name: Berry Blast
blurb: Tart, creamy and bright purple. A handful of berries and a banana, blitzed in a minute.

name: Banana Peanut Butter
blurb: Thick, malty and satisfying — closer to a treat than a drink, but it'll keep you going for hours.

name: Mango & Coconut
blurb: Sunshine in a glass — sweet mango, creamy coconut and a squeeze of lime to keep it sharp.

name: Tropical
blurb: Pineapple, mango and banana over orange juice. Tastes like a holiday, ready before you're out the door.

name: Chocolate Protein
blurb: Chocolatey, thick and properly filling — a post-workout or busy-morning standby.

name: Strawberry Banana
blurb: The classic everyone loves — sweet, smooth and ready in five minutes flat.

name: Blueberry Oat
blurb: Blueberries and oats blended into a smooth, steady-energy drink that eats like breakfast.
